metadata.description: Hackathon evaluation query set for the knowledge vector DB. Queries are written from the perspective of a salesperson or implementation consultant with solid product knowledge. Covers all 16 feature categories, 5 query types, and 3 difficulty tiers.

query_types.feature_lookup: Does a feature exist / what does it do?
query_types.routing: Which team do I contact / who owns this?
query_types.policy_config: Can we configure X for a customer?
query_types.synonym_probe: Queries using non-standard terminology — tests tags-cloud chunk

difficulty_levels.easy: Direct match to a feature name or sample question
difficulty_levels.medium: Requires semantic understanding or category inference
difficulty_levels.hard: Synonym-heavy, cross-feature, or targets in-dev / whitelisted features

queries.query: How does trip approval work?
queries.notes: Baseline test — direct match to a sample question. Score should be near 1.0.

queries.query: Can we set up multi-level approval for a customer?
queries.notes: Tests whether 'multi-level' resolves to trip approval workflow.

queries.query: Who do I contact to change the approval flow for a company?
queries.notes: Routing query — route_by_intent=True should surface contact_team section directly.

queries.query: Can domestic and international trips have different approvers?
queries.notes: Requires understanding that noOfApprovers and noOfApproversIntnl are separate fields.

queries.query: What happens if the approving manager is also travelling on the trip?
queries.notes: Tests whether the system maps 'manager is traveling' to the traveling-manager-skip feature.

queries.query: Can we auto-approve trips that are fully within policy?
queries.notes: Tests skip-in-policy-approvals — the phrase 'auto-approve within policy' is a business synonym.

queries.query: Can we restrict employees to Economy class only?
queries.notes: Policy query — 'economy only' should be in tags and sample questions.

queries.query: How do I allow Business class for senior leadership?
queries.notes: Requires inferring cabin class restriction from 'business class' + 'senior' context.

queries.query: Can we set a per-trip flight spend limit?
queries.notes: Tests spend-budget-cap. 'Spend limit' and 'budget cap' are synonyms.

queries.query: Can we cap hotel spend differently for domestic vs international?
queries.notes: Tests whether the domestic/international split is correctly attributed.

queries.query: How do we set up BTC payment for a customer?
queries.notes: 'BTC' is a specific acronym (Bill-to-Company) — tests acronym handling in tags.

queries.query: Can employees pay online at booking time instead of bill-to-company?
queries.notes: Same feature, different angle — 'pay now' vs 'BTC wallet'.

queries.query: Do we have cost centre tagging for trips?
queries.notes: Tests cost-centres feature. 'Tagging' and 'attribution' should be in synonyms.

queries.query: How do we attribute travel spend to a department?
queries.notes: Business phrasing for cost centre — tests synonym coverage.

queries.query: Can we capture custom data fields against trips?
queries.notes: Direct match to custom-fields feature.

queries.query: Can a company force users to log in only via SSO?
queries.notes: In-development feature — tests whether status filter affects retrieval. Pass status=None.

queries.query: Do we have duplicate booking detection?
queries.notes: In-development feature. Tests that in-dev features are returned when status=None.

queries.query: What is the OOP approval flow when an employee books out of policy?
queries.notes: 'OOP' is an acronym — tests tags-cloud chunk and acronym matching.

queries.query: Can we hide the out-of-policy override option from employees?
queries.notes: Two related features. Either is a valid answer. Tests disambiguation between similar features.

queries.query: Can we push trip data to the customer's own systems in real time?
queries.notes: Whitelisted feature. 'Push to their systems' is a business synonym for webhook. Tests tags-cloud.

queries.query: Do we have an HRMS sync capability?
queries.notes: Tests the new hrms-integration file added via git pull.

queries.query: Can we sync employee data from the customer's HR system?
queries.notes: Same feature, business phrasing. 'HR system' and 'HRMS' are synonyms.

queries.query: Do we have SAP integration?
queries.notes: Classic synonym probe. SAP is not directly named — tests whether ERP/HRMS tags surface the right features.

queries.query: Can we show employees a cheaper flight option when they pick expensive?
queries.notes: Tests flight-cheaper-rate-suggestion — 'cheaper alternative' phrasing.

queries.query: Can we block employees from booking flights more than 30 days in advance?
queries.notes: Advance purchase rule — 'days in advance' is the key phrase.

queries.query: Can employees book on behalf of a guest traveller?
queries.notes: Guest bookings category. Tests 'guest traveller' vs 'guest booking' terminology.

queries.query: Who do I contact to enable Insights V2 for a customer?
queries.notes: Whitelisted feature owned by Tech Team — routing query must return Tech Team, not Onboarding.

queries.query: Can we export trip data automatically to an external system?
queries.notes: Two possible features. Tests disambiguation between export (pull) and webhook (push).

queries.query: What reports does the platform provide out of the box?
queries.notes: Reporting category — tests whether 'reports' maps to the whitelisted reports module.

queries.query: How does a user create a trip step by step?
queries.notes: Tests the how-to guide added as a new knowledge file.

queries.query: Can a trip auto-expire if the employee doesn't act on it?
queries.notes: 'Auto-expire' and 'doesn't act on it' — tests summary retrieval for lifecycle features.

queries.query: Can we add the company logo to the platform?
queries.notes: Branding category. Simple lookup.

queries.query: Can we charge a management fee on top of bookings?
queries.notes: Invoicing category — 'management fee' terminology.

queries.query: Can employees modify a booking after it is confirmed?
queries.notes: Post-booking modification — 'after confirmed' is the key phrase.

queries.query: What travel modes can be enabled or disabled for a company?
queries.notes: Travel mode eligibility — tests whether 'modes' maps to the right feature.

queries.query: Can we set different travel policies for different employee grades?
queries.notes: Cross-feature query spanning policy targeting and mapping. Requires understanding of policy hierarchy.

queries.query: noOfApprovers
queries.notes: Exact technical key lookup — requires use_fts=True for best results.

queries.query: Can we enable frequent flyer number capture for employees?
queries.notes: Frequent flyer — owned by Tech Team (whitelisted). Tests correct team routing.

queries.query: Can we prevent employees from creating trips for certain date ranges?
queries.notes: Two features cover this — tests which one surfaces first. 'prevent' vs 'allow' framing.

queries.query: We have a customer asking why their employees can't see the cheaper refundable ticket — is there a feature for that?
queries.notes: Long conversational query. Tests whether 'refundable ticket' maps to fare type restriction.
